transcript: LEWIS:I feel likeI've been here for years. I mean, a day on Exile Island is like a month in the real world. This is, literally,a penitentiary. And at this point, there's no knowing what's around the corner. PROBST: You have a visitor. I'll come to you, brother. I see Jeff coming up,and I'm like, "This is brilliant.This is great." Someone to talk to. I've been waiting all day for something. -Anything. -PROBST: Really? LEWIS:But in Survivor, when you see Jeff, it's either really good news or really bad news. PROBST: What's going on? Holy crap. I'm just, like, sitting here in silence for... I don't know how long it's been. Well, you've been here about 30 hours... -(laughs) -already. Yeah. I mean, I feel like I have no answers. Do you remember the two words I said on the boat? You said uncertainty. Permanent. Permanent uncertainty. So, I come bearing some information. PROBST: Okay, I don't know that you're gonna love this information, but you're not leaving Exile Island today. You will not participate in the first immunity challenge. You're not going to Tribal Council, either, which means you will not be the first person voted out of this game. That was my first mission. -Accomplished. -Well, that makes Exile a little cheery. (chuckles) PROBST: So I also come bearing -opportunity. -I love opportunity. -So, this is brilliant. -Okay. But first, you got to earn it. -All right. -If you're successful, the opportunity would be an individual idol. -(laughs) -Yeah. LEWIS: I've been losing my mind hunting for an idol, so if I could get that idol... But I have to, like you say, -dig deep. But I don't know where to dig. -Mm-hmm. I'll show you where to dig. So you've been searching for idols. -I've been look... -Well, you just didn't look in the right spot. At the top of the mast, -Yeah?-there's a little pouch. The question is how do you get it? Let me explain. Here are the rules. You cannot climb up this and grab it. You cannot shake on this. You can't do anything to impact this mast, except one thing. -No. -Yeah. (Lewis laughs) This has to be a joke. I am not about to chop down this thick mast. I chopped down my Christmas tree this year, and it took us hours. I mean, that's a thick bit of wood. PROBST: Well, I may have more faith than you do, because I think if you had all day, there's no doubt that you would chop this down. (sighs, mutters) But, Lewis, you don't have all day. No, no, no, no, no, no, no. This is how much time you have. -How much time is that? -I'm gonna say that's part -of the permanent uncertainty. -Oh, no. Right now, I have an opportunityto get myself an idol, so I'm a full hundred percent confident. -Ready? -All right, Lewis, you're on. -Lewis, good luck. You're on your own, buddy. -All right. (grunting) You're looking good, Lewis! Welcome to Survivor Exile Island. I start off, and I'm whipping. I'm just, like, "Keep going, keep whacking that pole." (grunting)

is_notesOnly.instructions: Something happened in this excerpt that a Survivor fantasy league would want recorded even though it awards no points — a journey, a summit, a condition imposed on a castaway, or a game twist.

is_journey.instructions: One or more castaways were sent away from camp on a journey, to exile, or to a separate location in this excerpt.

castaways_chose.instructions: The castaways themselves chose who would go, rather than the host or the game assigning it.

one_person_only.instructions: Exactly one castaway was sent, not a group.

volunteered.instructions: The castaway who went volunteered themselves, rather than being chosen by the others.
